outcome: abnormalities of fetal growth (fetal growth restriction or large for gestational age)
abnormalities of amniotic fluid (oligohydramnios or polyhydramnios)
cohort: The study included low-risk pregnant individuals without existing indications for a third-trimester ultrasound examination.
finding: Implementation of a universal third-trimester ultrasound examination at 36.0-37.6 weeks in low-risk pregnancies attenuated composite neonatal and maternal adverse outcomes compared to routine care with indicated ultrasound examination.
mod_finding: Universal third-trimester ultrasound examination was associated with a reduction in cesarean delivery, with a number needed to prevent of 18.
